passages.sermon:
This is a song.
People sing this song while going up to Jerusalem.
The song is called a song of ascents.

passages.text: In my distress I cried to the LORD, and He answered me.
passages.sermon:
This is a song of ascents.
I was in distress.
I called to the LORD.
The LORD answered me.
passages.original: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת אֶל־ יְ֭הוָה בַּצָּרָ֣תָה לִּ֑י קָ֝רָ֗אתִי וַֽיַּעֲנֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips and a deceitful tongue.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
I ask the LORD to save me.
I want Him to protect my soul.
I need rescue from people who lie.
I need rescue from people who speak with a deceitful tongue.
passages.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה הַצִּ֣ילָה נַ֭פְשִׁי מִשְּׂפַת־ שֶׁ֑קֶר מִלָּשׁ֥וֹן רְמִיָּֽה׃

passages.text: What will He do to you, and what will be added to you, O deceitful tongue?
passages.sermon:
The psalmist speaks to a deceitful tongue.
A deceitful tongue tells lies.
God will respond to this deceitful tongue.
What will God give you, deceitful tongue?
What more will God add to you, deceitful tongue?
passages.original: מַה־ יִּתֵּ֣ן לְ֭ךָ וּמַה־ יֹּסִ֥יף לָ֗ךְ לָשׁ֥וֹן רְמִיָּֽה׃

passages.text: Sharp arrows will come from the warrior, with burning coals of the broom tree!
passages.sermon:
A warrior uses sharp arrows.
The arrows are very pointed.
Burning coals from the broom tree come with them.
The coals are hot and destructive.
The arrows and coals bring pain and harm.
passages.original: חִצֵּ֣י גִבּ֣וֹר שְׁנוּנִ֑ים עִ֝֗ם גַּחֲלֵ֥י רְתָמִֽים׃

passages.text: Woe to me that I dwell in Meshech, that I live among the tents of Kedar!
passages.sermon:
This is a song of ascents.
The speaker is a person who seeks peace.
The speaker feels distress.
The speaker says, “Woe to me.”
The speaker lives in Meshech.
The speaker also lives among the tents of Kedar.
Meshech and Kedar are places far from home.
The people in these places do not love peace.
The speaker feels sorrow because of this.
passages.original: אֽוֹיָה־ לִ֭י כִּי־ גַ֣רְתִּי מֶ֑שֶׁךְ שָׁ֝כַ֗נְתִּי עִֽם־ אָהֳלֵ֥י קֵדָֽר׃

passages.text: Too long have I dwelt among those who hate peace.
passages.sermon: The speaker is a person who loves peace.\r\nThis person has lived for a long time among people who hate peace.\r\nThe speaker’s soul has dwelt too long with those who are enemies of peace.
passages.original: רַ֭בַּת שָֽׁכְנָה־ לָּ֣הּ נַפְשִׁ֑י עִ֝֗ם שׂוֹנֵ֥א שָׁלֽוֹם׃

passages.text: I am in favor of peace; but when I speak, they want war.
passages.sermon:
I am a person who loves peace.
I desire peace.
When I speak,
the people around me want war.
They do not want peace.
They choose conflict instead.
passages.original: אֲ‍ֽנִי־ שָׁ֭לוֹם וְכִ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר הֵ֝֗מָּה לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
